item: row 318 (R791): Verify never calls a file reached through a link verified
summary: verify_folder_backup reports a member reached through a link (category folder, folder below, the file, or another device) as link_not_checked, never read, a failure; opens members by handle with restore's opener and hashes from the handle; refuses non-plain manifest names by name; never raises (new unreadable status); a link or mount no entry names fails the verdict too, as it leaves a restore incomplete. Strings and Help x12.
